responsibility: Provides GCC’s primary x86 AVX-512F intrinsic header, defining the fundamental 512-bit vector and mask types plus the baseline AVX-512 operation set. It owns the core full-width API for construction, arithmetic, masking, conversions, movement, permutation, and reduction helpers on __m512/__m512i/__m512d values, forming the base layer on which the narrower VL and feature-specific AVX-512 headers build.
